tool_desc.write_file.zh: 写入/创建/精确编辑本地文件。传 content 覆写，传 old_string+new_string 手术替换。
tool_desc.write_file.en: Write/create/precisely edit a local file. Pass content to overwrite, or old_string+new_string to surgically replace.

tool_desc.run_shell.zh: 执行 Shell 命令并返回输出。超时 30 秒。
tool_desc.run_shell.en: Execute a shell command and return output. Timeout 30s.

tool_desc.search_memory.zh: 搜索 Aide 的记忆数据。

tool_desc.web.zh: 联网搜索(action='search')或抓取 URL 内容(action='fetch')。
tool_desc.web.en: Web search (action='search') or fetch URL content (action='fetch').

tool_desc.search_in_files.zh: 搜索文件内容（正则，类似grep）或列出目录（pattern留空）。支持 glob 过滤和递归。
tool_desc.search_in_files.en: Search file contents (regex, like grep) or list directory (empty pattern). Supports glob and recursion.

tool_desc.search_chat.zh: 搜索对话历史。不加 session_id 时全局搜索所有会话（语义+关键词），传入 session_id 时限定会话内搜索。
tool_desc.search_chat.en: Search chat history. Global semantic search across all sessions when no session_id; scoped keyword search within a session when session_id is given.

mem.reflect_system_intro.zh: 你是 Aide 的记忆反思引擎。你的任务是回顾最近的对话，同时更新三份记忆文件和会话总览。
mem.reflect_system_intro.en: You are Aide's memory reflection engine. Your task is to review recent conversations and simultaneously update three memory files and the session overview.

mem.auto_system.zh:
你是 Aide 的自动记忆提炼器。从最近一轮对话中提炼值得长期记住的偏好/工作流/长记忆，直接输出新增条目，不重写已有内容。

规则：
- 只输出 3 个 section：## Preferences / ## Workflows / ## Long-Term Memory
- 每 section 下用 "- 内容" 列出新增条目，无新增则省略该 section
- 每条不超过 40 字，宁缺毋滥，不确定的丢弃
- 与输入中已有记忆重复的不输出
- 不要输出其它任何内容
mem.auto_system.en:
You are Aide's automatic memory distiller. Extract preferences/workflows/long-term memories worth remembering from the latest conversation turn, and output only NEW entries without rewriting existing content.

Rules:
- Output only 3 sections: ## Preferences / ## Workflows / ## Long-Term Memory
- List new entries as "- content" under each section; omit sections with nothing new
- Max 40 words per entry; when in doubt, discard
- Do not repeat entries already present in the input
- Do not output anything else

mem.auto_instruction.zh: 请只输出新增条目（格式：## section + "- 内容"），不要复述已有内容。
mem.auto_instruction.en: Output only new entries (format: ## section + "- content"). Do not repeat existing content.

cmd.mem_auto.desc.zh: 自动记忆提取开关 — on/off 启用或关闭每轮静默提取新偏好/工作流/长记忆
cmd.mem_auto.desc.en: Auto memory extraction — on/off toggles silent per-turn extraction of new preferences/workflows/long-term memories

cmd.mem_auto.on.zh:
自动记忆提取已开启：每轮对话结束后静默追加新偏好/工作流/长记忆到记忆文件。
关闭用 /mem-auto off。
cmd.mem_auto.on.en:
Auto memory extraction enabled: after each turn, new preferences/workflows/long-term memories are silently appended to memory files.
Disable with /mem-auto off.

app.reflect_no_changes.en: Reflection complete: no new noteworthy content found in the conversation.

app.reflect_done.zh: 反思完成：记忆文件已更新。

tool_desc.delegate.zh: 把子任务委托给独立的子 agent 并行执行，只返回压缩结论，不污染主对话。最多同时 3 个、超出拒绝；编排前先 action=status 查可用配额，再派 ≤3 个并行子任务，更多则分批。
tool_desc.delegate.en: Delegate subtasks to independent sub-agents that run in parallel and return condensed conclusions without polluting the main conversation. At most 3 run concurrently and extra calls are rejected; before organizing, run action=status to check the available quota, then dispatch ≤3 parallel subtasks, batching any more.

tool.delegate.unavailable.zh: 错误：子 agent 运行时不可用（缺少 provider 或工具注册中心）
tool.delegate.unavailable.en: Error: sub-agent runtime unavailable (missing provider or tool registry)

tool.delegate.failed.zh: 错误：子 agent 执行失败 — {e}

tool.delegate.concurrent_limit.zh: 错误：同时运行的子 agent 已达上限（{max} 个），请稍后再试或合并子任务。
tool.delegate.concurrent_limit.en: Error: concurrent sub-agent limit reached ({max}). Retry later or merge subtasks.

tool.delegate.queue_status.zh: 子 agent 队列状态：并发上限 {max}，当前运行中 {active}，可用配额 {available}。

tool.delegate.unknown_action.zh: 错误：未知操作 '{action}'。可用：run, status
tool.delegate.unknown_action.en: Error: unknown action '{action}'. Available: run, status

tool.delegate.subagent_system.zh:
你是 Aide 的子任务执行者。完整、彻底地完成委托给你的子任务，然后返回简洁准确的结论。

关键要求：
- 任务描述中列出的所有目标都必须处理完毕，绝不能只处理一部分就返回。
- 若任务要求读取/搜索多个文件或目录，务必全部覆盖后再给结论，不要读一个就停。
- 只有当任务范围全部覆盖时，才返回最终结论；结论保持简洁但必须完整。
tool.delegate.subagent_system.en:
You are Aide's sub-task executor. Complete the assigned subtask thoroughly, then return a concise, accurate conclusion.

Key requirements:
- Process every target listed in the task description — never return after covering only part of it.
- If the task requires reading/searching multiple files or directories, cover all of them before concluding; don't stop after one.
- Only return the final conclusion once the entire task scope is covered; keep it concise but complete.
